I paid the surgery to provide medical notes, only for Dr K. Mather who never met me or spoke with me to hand write a quite unprofessional, and condescending summary of my medical history. Alarmingly, she added an arrow to a medication I was prescribed but chose not to take, as advised to take only if needed, and noted it as ‘did not take.’ Note here this was 5 years previous when I was not even a patient at the practice!

Her wording made it appear as though I had approached the GP for help for conditions but deliberately refused treatment, which is completely inaccurate and unfair. This shows a lack of regard for the effort, time, and care patients put into managing their health. Patients lives exist outside the GP practice, and careless accounts like this can have real life consequences, in this case an application I spent 5 months of my life working very hard towards.

I sincerely hope that in the future she takes the time to meet with patients before blindly and ignorantly writing about them and considers the impact that a seemingly bad day for her can have on others. I also hope if she ever requires the time and support of services outside of her job role, that she is not met with such ignorance but instead kindness and time. It almost feels like she went out of her way to provide a negative account, when she was merely asked to provide medical notes. There are many good doctors out there, I am afraid it appears this is not one of them.",null,[0,103]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGMVkwRTFaWE13Ym5FNU4yWXhablJaV0hkVFdVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x9c10db7ab46a813!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkF1Y0E1ZXMwbnE5N2YxZnRZWHdTWUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGMVkwRTFaWE13Ym5FNU4yWXhablJaV0hkVFdVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiQzbanx7CTAxWIQAkBHbGVH0cQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiQzbanx7CTAxWIQAkBHbGVH0cQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWRtU21SWGVWOWZSV2hCT1ZrMWJWbHZWRmx5YWtSbGIyZDNhMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSVFVOYVdqaHNNV0pKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWdlJqVnRXRGMxV0RaZlZYbFhOblJvT1hRNFluYxAB",["0x0:0x9c10db7ab46a813",null,1754661065422835,1754661065422835,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112341302505361668995/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Amanda Dance","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXmuireHskym9kYjkKQ_ydMpjg41Op0eGiKTRRO1VP_udyYbfBL=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112341302505361668995?hl=en"],"112341302505361668995",null,8,1,null,[0,3,1],0,["8 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiQzbanx7CTAxWIQAkBHbGVH0cQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"7 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["The best doctors surgery EVER!!
